overview_description.description: RenoHome.ae is a Dubai/UAE-based renovation and interior design platform that combines home renovation services with a mobile app for project tracking, approvals, payments, and contractor coordination. It mainly targets homeowners, Airbnb investors, landlords, and property investors in the UAE.
